narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Add the tops and add the bottoms, so the sum is ten fourteenths.
<bookmark mark='fourteen'/>Ten fourteenths is the same as five sevenths, less than the cousin's six sevenths alone.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A sum of two shares can never be smaller than one of the shares.
